title: Leaderboards: the global score and guild points
summary: How the Global leaderboard score is computed, which boards exist and how guild points are earned.

Totals count both profiles of your account (except the level). In practice: one level is worth 100 points, one dungeon 150, one hour of play 60 and a million shards 10,000.

blocks.text: Each dungeon cleared gives points to your guild, depending on its rank: E 5, D 10, C 20, B 40, A 80, S 160, S+ 260, Nation 400 (×2 in a guild raid, ×1.5 for a rift break). See Guilds .
